model.name: Pin management skill (CurrentSprint lifecycle)
model.description: The Current Sprint pin lifecycle is an Object.verb skill (planner-drive.ts / CurrentSprint) with verbs focus, hop, gate, setChain, advance, pin, status: focus auto-derives the chain from the focused task, hop applies a per-agent realtime hop update (req|uc|class|method|impl|test x pending|in-progress|done|gate-proven), gate checks whether the task-switch gate is proven, and advance moves the pin only on a gate-proven test hop.
model.poDirective: PO directive 2026-06-29: formalize the scattered traceability + MD-planning TS tools (planner-drive.ts, objectVerb.ts, generate-sprint-md.ts, trace-cli.ts/trace-audit.ts) as a coherent OOSH-like SKILL set - pin management, chain scoring, sprint planning, traceability audit.
model.sourceNote: PO-formulated main goal (not a verbatim Tron literal); formalizes existing impl. Grounded per implRef.

acceptanceCriteria.text: focus <task> auto-derives the chain from the focused task; blocked if the current task test hop is not gate-proven (unless --force).
hop <hop> <status> [agent] applies a per-agent realtime hop update over req|uc|class|method|impl|test with statuses pending|in-progress|done|gate-proven.
gate reports whether the task-switch gate is proven (test hop gate-proven).
setChain wires req/uc/class/method/impl/test + sprint + task into the pin.

advance increments the active-hop pointer (req->uc->class->method->impl->test); pin/status report the current pin (pinCurrent). NOTE: the gate-proven block currently lives on focus/task-switch (AC-1), not advance - gating advance on gate-proven is TARGET behaviour for the formalized skill.
The Pin lifecycle verbs (focus/hop/gate/setChain/advance/pin/status) are Object.verb methods on a Pin/CurrentSprint class, NOT ad-hoc argv handlers.
Removal of the planner-drive shim is gated on pin-parity: the Object.verb Pin surface must reproduce planner-drive behaviour before the shim is retired.
getThreeSlots returns the 3-slot pin - current / lastCompleted / nextBacklog - the core Current-Sprint pin model.
setNextBacklog / clearNextBacklog pin and clear the nextBacklog slot (a real planner-drive verb, part of the 3-slot pin).
hopUpdate records the acting agent on the hop; owner-rejection (rejecting a wrong owner) is NOT enforced today - TARGET behaviour for the formalized skill.
